depo.title:
Customers who
love us 😍
depo.sub: Real stories from people who tried it and fell for the authentic taste of açaí raiz.
depo.t1: "I had never tried it. It's really different, but I liked it!"
depo.t2: "Really different, and it has a lot of benefits. I'm drinking it instead of coffee because of the caffeine. Highly recommend!"
depo.t3: "The flavour is quite different. I like that it has no caffeine."
depo.t4: "I like that it doesn't have that really strong coffee taste — it's more like a strong tea."
